verdict.rationale: HubSpot publishes a dated API reference with per-endpoint pages that carry inline OpenAPI 3.0.1 specs, and its guides include concrete request examples such as POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts. Developers also get up to 10 test accounts for safe experimentation. However, nothing in the evidence shows an interactive 'try it' console or runnable examples inside the reference itself. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser request runner, runnable or executable code samples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
